The formula floor(floor(r/2)/(k-r))=floor(r/(2(k-r))) holds with all endpoints. The packaged verifier independently checked 83 orbit comparisons, 198880 fold deletions and 78 mod-2 homology cases. Finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The problem is the actual geometric symmetry-fixed topology of the constant-weight slice of the binary cube throughout its Johnson-distance Rips filtration, an object not encoded by ambient homology alone. The theorem gives a complete integral single-sphere homotopy classification at all integer scales and a sharp eventual contractibility threshold; its penultimate-scale sphere dimensions grow arbitrarily large. The explicit PL orbit-complex and uniform elementary collapses are structural results, not a small isolated computation or relabeling of the ambient scale-one theorem.
